The '''Brimstone chest''' is located adjacent to [[Konar quo Maten]] on [[Mount Karuulm]]. This chest is locked and can only be opened by using a [[brimstone key]], which players can acquire from slaying monsters assigned by Konar.

The likelihood of obtaining the key is 1/100 for level 100 monsters and 1/50 for level 350 monsters, scaling linearly and capping at 350 as shown in formula 2.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Kieren|url=https://twitter.com/JagexKieren/status/1083781544135847936|date=16 January 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106148|archivedate=26 May 2020|quote=It follows a curve up until level 100 then scales linearly between those 2 values upto level 350 combat. Creatures over this{{sic}} will cap at 1/50. [https://pbs.twimg.com/media/DwpdLK2W0AEynZy.jpg]}} For lower level monsters, it follows a curve as shown in formula 1.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Kieren|url=https://twitter.com/JagexKieren/status/1083783815141707781|date=16 January 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/97247|archivedate=29 April 2020|quote=0.2*(CBLEVEL - 100)^2 + 100}}

<math>\begin{align}
P(L) &= \frac{1}{100 + \lfloor (100 - L)^2/5 \rfloor} & L \in (0, 100) && (1) \\
P(L) &= \frac{1}{120 - \lfloor L/5 \rfloor} & L \in [100, 350] && (2)
\end{align}</math>

<math>
\text{Where P is the probability of a drop and L is the monster's combat level.}
</math>

==Loot==
{{DropLogProject|kills=787160|type=openings}} <!-- Per Cook, using this number for both Larran's chests and brimstone chests -->

The contents of the brimstone chest generally consist of generic loot designed to increase player profits. There is also a rare chance of obtaining a [[broken dragon hasta]], which can be repaired for free by simply showing it to [[Otto Godblessed]]. Additionally, there's a slim chance of acquiring pieces of the dusk [[mystic robes|mystic robe set]], featuring a colour scheme similar to that of [[Mount Karuulm]].

On average, a player would need to open the Brimstone Chest approximately 2,284 times to acquire at least one of each [[Mystic_robes#Dusk|dusk mystic]] piece and at least one [[broken dragon hasta]] to fulfil the respective [[collection log]] slots.

{{Average drop value|killname=opening}}{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/revised-post-kebos-poll-blog?oldschool=1|title=Revised Post Kebos Poll Blog|newsdate=21 January 2019|quote=}} 

Fish add {{Coins|{{Slayer chest fish value|chest=brimstone|level=1}}}} to the average value at level 1 [[Fishing]], and {{Coins|{{Slayer chest fish value|chest=brimstone|level=99}}}} at level 99.

===Fish drop table===
There is a 1/20 chance to receive raw fish, with the specific type of raw fish obtained being dependent on the player's [[Fishing]] level.

{{DropsTableHead}}
{{DropsLineReward|name=Raw tuna|quantity=100-350 (noted)|rarity=Varies}}
{{DropsLineReward|name=Raw lobster|quantity=100-350 (noted)|rarity=Varies}}
{{DropsLineReward|name=Raw swordfish|quantity=100-300 (noted)|rarity=Varies}}
{{DropsLineReward|name=Raw monkfish|quantity=100-300 (noted)|rarity=Varies}}
{{DropsLineReward|name=Raw shark|quantity=80-250 (noted)|rarity=Varies}}
{{DropsLineReward|name=Shark lure|quantity=160-500|quantitynotes=<ref group=d>Only drops in multiples of two (160, 162, ..., 498, 500). The average quantity is 330.</ref>|rarity=Varies}}
{{DropsLineReward|name=Raw sea turtle|quantity=80-200 (noted)|rarity=Varies}}
{{DropsLineReward|name=Raw manta ray|quantity=80-160 (noted)|rarity=Varies}}
{{DropsTableBottom}}

Upon hitting the fish drop table, sequential rolls are made until one succeeds, starting with raw manta rays and ending with raw lobsters in case all rolls fail. Succeeding on a shark, sea turtle, or manta ray roll has a chance to instead reward raw sharks or shark lures.

The following chart shows the chance ''per fish roll'' to receive a particular type of fish. Divide the values in the chart by 20 to calculate the chance ''per chest opening''.

==Trivia==
*Several items can be seen inside the brimstone chest while it is open, including piles of coins, stacks of [[bank note]]s, and vials of [[Saradomin brew]]. This is a reference to the loot players can receive from the chest, although Saradomin brews were removed from Konar's drop table shortly after release.
